summary: Cheniere Energy Partners, a subsidiary of Cheniere Energy, filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of $1B 5.350% Senior Notes due 2036 and $750M 6.050% Senior Notes due 2056 via a purchase agreement with BofA Securities. The notes are priced at 99.511% and 99.698% of par, respectively. Concurrently, SPL redeemed $1.5B of 5.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2027. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation, as it involves standard note issuance and refinancing without a change of control, acquisition, or strategic event.
